theorem: For every finite two-input-per-party output architecture, the convex hull of qubit POVM behaviors equals the convex hull of fixed-qubit PVM behaviors.
setting_classification: Two inputs per party never separate; the inherited exact 3-by-2 construction is setting-minimal up to party exchange.
incidence_constraints: F_j(P,g)=(P r_j)^T g^{-1}(P r_j)=0 for j=1,...,5, with u^T P u=1.
normal_tensor: c-alpha*u*u^T = -2*g^{-1}*P*Lambda, where Lambda=sum_j lambda_j*r_j*r_j^T and lambda_j>0 at a strict separator.
second_form: q(W)=Tr(S W Lambda W^T), S=P^T g^{-1} P; q has inertia (4,12) on M_4(R).

rank_cases.rank_D_at_least_2: The tangent W-space has dimension at least 13, hence contains q(W)>0, contradicting local maximality.
rank_cases.rank_D_equal_1: Projective injectivity of the null-ray map implies exactly one nonzero D-row, so ker(D^T) contains no strictly positive multiplier.
rank_cases.rank_D_equal_0: The transformed outcome pentad permutes the original five null rays; the resulting behavior has an explicit deterministic local/PVM decomposition.
